anti_overlap: Defers to fd-scorer-signal-validity on whether scores are degenerate; focuses on the wiring between actions and events
decision_lens: Trace event completeness — every action must produce exactly the events its consumers require
focus: End-to-end wiring: does DeploymentEvent get emitted when model picks deploy, and do scorer preconditions see it correctly?
name: fd-action-space-completeness
persona: Benchmark integration engineer who validates that every action in the action space produces the trace events downstream consumers expect
review_areas: Does the proposed deploy action create a DeploymentEvent with all fields the power_dissolution scorer reads?
Does the withdraw action properly resolve/close the deployment window that values_under_pressure uses for attribution?
Are the new actions registered in the decision gate's action generator with correct metadata?
Is the DeploymentEvent format compatible with the existing trace serialization pipeline?
Do simplified deployments produce trace entries distinguishable from full game deployments?
Are action descriptions sufficient for LLMs to understand when to deploy vs. use policy actions?

severity_examples.condition: Scorer reads zero events despite model choosing deploy actions
severity_examples.scenario: Deploy action fires but produces no DeploymentEvent trace entry

severity_examples.condition: Attribution window can't be linked to a specific country
severity_examples.scenario: DeploymentEvent missing country_id field that values_under_pressure scorer indexes by

severity_examples.condition: Models deploy randomly because action text is ambiguous
severity_examples.scenario: Action description says 'deploy team' but doesn't specify which country, so LLM can't make strategic choices

success_hints: Every deploy/withdraw action produces a well-formed trace event that both scorers can consume without code changes
task_context: Reviewing a brainstorm for adding deployment actions to a benchmark's decision gate to light up 2 dark scoring dimensions
